text:
Echo State Networks (ESNs) are a type of recurrent neural network used for processing time-series data. They consist of a large, fixed-size hidden layer called a reservoir, which is typically sparsely connected. The weights of the reservoir are usually set randomly and are not trained. Only the weights between the reservoir and the output layer are trained using a simple linear regression. Training involves exposing the network to input data and adjusting the output weights to minimize prediction error.
